__unit.backstory: Elsa Dunmore was born to the Dunmores, a Millmere family that keeps 6 acres of mixed crops, 3 acres of apples and 12 pigs. She went in the militia for a season in the spring of year 1. She spent a season as a herbalist's hand at Rowan Underhill's herbalist that summer, and she has been a keeper of the tailor at Yorick Dunmore's tailor since that autumn. But the tax left the Dunmores owing the lord 5 coins that winter. Very passive and still 4 coins in debt to the lord, Elsa has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and she dreams of avenging her home.
__unit.name: Elsa Dunmore
__unit.title: keeper of the tailor

__unit.backstory: Yorick Dunmore grew up among the Dunmores in Millmere, who keep 6 acres of mixed crops, 3 acres of apples and 12 pigs. He spent two seasons as a keeper of the tailor at Yorick Dunmore's tailor in the spring of year 1, and then his wife Mina Dunmore died in battle with the army that spring. Since that autumn, Yorick has been a swineherd on the family herd, but the Dunmores came up 5 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the lord that winter. Unscrupulous and still 4 coins in debt to the lord, Yorick has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Yorick Dunmore
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Edwin Thorne comes from the Thornes of Millmere, who keep 18 acres of mixed crops and 9 acres of apples. The tax left the Thornes owing the lord 5 coins in the summer of year 1. After that, the Thornes borrowed 86 coins from the lord for food that autumn. The flux took his granddaughter Thea Thorne that autumn. Passive and owing the lord 74 coins, Edwin stands before you wanting a captain's pay, and one day he means to avenge his home.
__unit.name: Edwin Thorne
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Hugh Kettle grew up among the Kettles in Millmere, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops and 5 acres of apples, and he has been a keeper of the smelter at Hugh Kettle's smelter since the spring of year 1, handy with the hammers he likes. But that winter, the Kettles came up 17 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the lord. Very modest and still 16 coins in debt to the lord, Hugh now asks you for a soldier's daily pay, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Hugh Kettle
__unit.title: keeper of the smelter

__unit.backstory: Sigrun Kettle was born to the Kettles, a Millmere family that keeps 10 acres of mixed crops and 5 acres of apples, and she spent a few weeks in the family's barley in the spring of year 1. After that, she worked the family's mixed crops for three seasons that spring, but the Kettles came up 17 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the lord that winter. So Sigrun went with the caravans for a few weeks that winter. Very reckless and 16 coins in debt to the lord, she now asks you for a soldier's daily pay, and she dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Sigrun Kettle
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Edda Ashford was born to the Ashfords, a Millmere family that keeps 5 acres of mixed crops, 2 acres of apples and 46 pigs. She went in the militia for two seasons in the spring of year 1, and then she served with the caravans for a few weeks that winter. Then, that winter, the Ashfords borrowed 172 coins from the lord for firewood. Very jumpy and still 171 coins in debt to the lord, Edda stands before you wanting a captain's pay, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Edda Ashford
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Elin Ashford is one of the Ashfords of Millmere, who keep 5 acres of mixed crops, 2 acres of apples and 46 pigs, and her daughter-in-law Edda Ashford went off to serve in the militia of Millmere in the spring of year 1. That summer, her daughter-in-law Edda Ashford walked home unpaid from the militia, and then the lord lent the family 172 coins for firewood that winter. Very loyal and still 171 coins in debt to the lord, Elin now asks you for a soldier's daily pay, and one day she means to avenge her home.
__unit.name: Elin Ashford
__unit.title: past working age

contracts.desc: A band of a score or so goblins from the Warrens of Skrag has been preying on the roads around Stonecross. Find them and destroy them within 11 days.
contracts.title: Hunt down goblins

contracts.desc: The Kingdom of the Middle March is at war with the Red Tusk Horde. A war band of orcs is marching through the borderlands near Stonecross; break it within 11 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.
contracts.title: War: break a war band of orcs

contracts.desc: Wolves are killing livestock and worse around Stonecross. Hunt them down within 6 days. They roam near the village; pelts and trophies are yours to sell.
contracts.title: Hunt the wolves

contracts.desc: A price is on the head of Old Gutripper, a great wild boar from the boar wallow near Emberforge. The longer it lives, the more Stonecross pays. 12 days.
contracts.title: Bounty: Old Gutripper

contracts.desc: Merchants of Stonecross need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 4 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 11 days.
contracts.title: Escort a caravan

contracts.desc: The lords of Stonecross only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of orcs from the Red Tusk Horde is loose in the country. Destroy it within 10 days.
contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break orcs

__unit.backstory: Leofric Redhand was born to the Redhands, a Stonecross family that owns no field, so he worked as a hired farmhand at Odo Kettle's Pear Orchard for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. Then, that winter, he spent a few weeks as a hired farmhand at Ida Thorne's Barley And Oats Farm, and he has been a hired farmhand at Piers Dunmore's Hay Farm since that winter, handy with the axes he likes. But that winter, Joan Holloway's Oats Farm stopped paying the Redhands. Merciful and still owed one week of wages, Leofric has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and he dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Leofric Redhand
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Ursel Vane grew up among the Vanes in Stonecross, who own no field, so she worked as a leatherworker's hand at Aldric Stone's leatherworker for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. Then, that autumn, she spent a season as a hired farmhand at Piers Dunmore's Hay Farm. She has been a hired farmhand at Conrad Holloway's Hay Farm since that autumn, but Conrad Holloway's Hay Farm stopped paying the Vanes that winter. Very jumpy and still owed one week of wages, Ursel has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and she dreams of avenging her home.
__unit.name: Ursel Vane
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Nell Holloway is one of the Holloways of Stonecross, who own no field, so she worked as a hired farmhand at Piers Dunmore's Hay Farm for a season in the autumn of year 1. Then, that winter, she spent a season as a hired farmhand at Conrad Holloway's Hay Farm, but Conrad Holloway's Hay Farm stopped paying the Holloways that winter. Since that winter, Nell has worked as a hired farmhand at Ida Thorne's Barley And Oats Farm, handy with the spears she likes. Very glory-hungry and unpaid for two weeks, she has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and one day she means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Nell Holloway
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Spleck Ratbiter clawed up among the Ratbiters, a Mireburrow brood that keeps 7 goats, and he has scraped by as a hired farmhand at Mog Sharpgrin's Fig Orchard since the winter of year 1. But that winter, Snik Sharpgrin's weapon forge stiffed the Ratbiters of their pay. Very aggressive and still owed two weeks of wages, Spleck grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Spleck Ratbiter
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Wrag Ratbiter clawed up among the Ratbiters, a Mireburrow brood that keeps 7 goats, and he has scraped by as a keeper of the weaponsmith at Snik Sharpgrin's weapon forge since the spring of year 1, handy with the hammers he likes. But Snik Sharpgrin's weapon forge stiffed the Ratbiters of their pay that winter. Cautious and still owed two weeks of wages, Wrag grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Wrag Ratbiter
__unit.title: keeper of the weaponsmith

__unit.backstory: Pip Ratbiter was spawned into the Ratbiters, a Mireburrow brood that keeps 7 goats, and she scraped by as a goatherd on the family herd for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. That winter, she spent a few weeks as a smelter's hand at Zit Sharpgrin's smelter, and she has scraped by as a smith's striker at Snik Sharpgrin's weapon forge since that winter. But Snik Sharpgrin's weapon forge stiffed the Ratbiters of their pay that winter. Two weeks unpaid now, Pip offers you her knife for first pick of the plunder, and one day she means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Pip Ratbiter
__unit.title: smith's striker

__unit.backstory: Squee Sharpgrin clawed up among the Sharpgrins, a Muckburrow brood that owns no field, so she did a year on the warren watch in the spring of year 1. Since that winter, she has scraped by as a hired farmhand at Spleck of Skrag's Fig Orchard, but Spleck of Skrag's Fig Orchard stiffed the Sharpgrins of their pay that winter. Very greedy and one week unpaid now, Squee grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and one day she means to see the world.
__unit.name: Squee Sharpgrin
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Mib Quickknife was spawned into the Quickknifes, a Muckburrow brood that owns no field, so she scraped by as a woodcutter at Vrex Quickknife's woodcutter for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. Then, that winter, she spent a few weeks as a hired farmhand at Yip Ratbiter's Fig Orchard, but Yip Ratbiter's Fig Orchard stiffed the Quickknifes of their pay that winter. Since that winter, Mib has scraped by as a hired farmhand at Rixa Mudfoot's Beans Farm. Very cautious and unpaid for two weeks, she offers you her knife for first pick of the plunder, and one day she means to avenge her home.
__unit.name: Mib Quickknife
__unit.title: hired farmhand

contracts.desc: The chief of Morruk wants the heads of a band of a score or so humans from the Kingdom of the Middle March roaming nearby. Kill them all within 8 days and the chief pays in coin.
contracts.title: Bring back human heads

contracts.desc: The Red Tusk Horde is at war with the Clans of the Northern Fells. A war band of humans is marching through the borderlands near Morruk; break it within 13 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.
contracts.title: War: break a war band of humans

contracts.desc: Wolves are killing livestock and worse around Morruk. Hunt them down within 8 days. They roam near the village; pelts and trophies are yours to sell.
contracts.title: Hunt the wolves

contracts.desc: A price is on the head of Greymuzzle, a great wolf from the wolf den near Hrafnstad. The longer it lives, the more Morruk pays. 13 days.
contracts.title: Bounty: Greymuzzle

contracts.desc: Merchants of Morruk need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 3 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 10 days.
contracts.title: Escort a caravan

contracts.desc: The lords of Morruk only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of humans from the Kingdom of the Middle March is loose in the country. Destroy it within 10 days.
contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break humans

__unit.backstory: Grisha Skullsplitter was whelped among the Skullsplitters, a war clan of Morruk that keeps 12 acres of mixed crops, 5 pigs and 5 goats, and she has worked the barley with the rest of the Skullsplitters since the spring of year 1. After that, her husband Brug Skullsplitter went off to serve in the militia of Morruk that spring. The warlord lent the clan 160 coins for food that autumn, and then the Skullsplitters came up 7 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the warlord that winter. Very selfish and still 148 coins in debt to the warlord, Grisha has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and she dreams of becoming a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Grisha Skullsplitter
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Durz Skullsplitter was whelped among the Skullsplitters, a war clan of Morruk that keeps 12 acres of mixed crops, 5 pigs and 5 goats. His son Brug Skullsplitter went off to serve in the militia of Morruk in the spring of year 1. After that, the warlord lent the clan 160 coins for food that autumn. After that, the Skullsplitters came up 7 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the warlord that winter. Very brave and still 148 coins in debt to the warlord, Durz has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Durz Skullsplitter
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Ghazka Gutripper is of the Gutrippers, one of the brutal war clans of Morruk, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, one acre of flax, 5 goats and 11 pigs, and she worked the clan's barley for three seasons in the spring of year 1. Since that autumn, she has worked the mixed crops with the rest of the Gutrippers, but the tax left the Gutrippers owing the warlord 11 coins that winter. Very reckless and still 10 coins in debt to the warlord, Ghazka has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and she dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Ghazka Gutripper
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Narg Gutripper fought his way up among the Gutrippers of Morruk, a war clan that keeps 10 acres of mixed crops, one acre of flax, 5 goats and 11 pigs. He slaved a season as a swineherd on the family herd in the spring of year 1, and then he marched with the caravans for a few weeks that summer. That winter, the tax left the Gutrippers owing the warlord 11 coins. Hot-tempered and still 10 coins in debt to the warlord, Narg bares his tusks at your table and demands plunder and a place in your war band, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Narg Gutripper
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Yagga Skinflayer was whelped among the Skinflayers, a war clan of Morruk that has lost its roof, so she slaved a season as a kitchen hand in the winter of year 1. Then, that winter, the Skinflayer hide-and-bone tent fell to ruin with no coin to mend it. The clan took places in the poorhouse that winter, and Yagga has lived on poorhouse broth since that winter. Very aggressive and still on poorhouse broth, a winter now, she bares her tusks at your table and demands plunder and a place in your war band, and one day she means to get rich.
__unit.name: Yagga Skinflayer
__unit.title: in the poorhouse

__unit.backstory: Narg Skinflayer fought his way up among the Skinflayers of Morruk, a war clan that has lost its roof, so he sweated as a hired farmhand at Gorbag Ironjaw the elder's Barley And Beans Farm for a season in the autumn of year 1. The old hide-and-bone tent came down and nobody could pay to rebuild it that winter, and then the Skinflayers went into the town poorhouse that winter. Since that winter, Narg has sweated as a kitchen hand. Very cruel and on poorhouse broth for a winter, he has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Narg Skinflayer
__unit.title: kitchen hand

__unit.backstory: Vrasha Gutripper is of the Gutrippers, one of the brutal war clans of Thragruk, who keep 29 acres of mixed crops and 21 pigs, and she marched with the clan spears for two seasons in the spring of year 1. That summer, her daughter Grisha Gutripper came home from the town guard unpaid, and then the Gutrippers came up 26 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the warchief that winter. Very reckless and still 27 coins in debt to the warchief, Vrasha bares her tusks at your table and demands plunder and a place in your war band, and one day she means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Vrasha Gutripper
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Grisha Gutripper was whelped among the Gutrippers, a war clan of Thragruk that keeps 29 acres of mixed crops and 21 pigs, and she marched in service for a season in the spring of year 1. She has worked the mixed crops with the rest of the Gutrippers since that summer. After that, her mother Vrasha Gutripper walked home unpaid from the militia that summer, and then the tax left the Gutrippers owing the warchief 26 coins that winter. Very glory-hungry and still 27 coins in debt to the warchief, Grisha has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and she dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Grisha Gutripper
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Shagg Gutripper is of the Gutrippers, one of the brutal war clans of Thragruk, who keep 29 acres of mixed crops and 21 pigs. He has sweated as a keeper of the weaponsmith at Mazga Bonechewer's weapon forge since the spring of year 1. After that, his wife Vrasha Gutripper went off to serve in the militia of Thragruk that spring. After that, his wife Vrasha Gutripper came home from the militia unpaid that summer. The tax left the Gutrippers owing the warchief 26 coins that winter. A glutton, still 27 coins in debt to the warchief, Shagg has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Shagg Gutripper
__unit.title: keeper of the weaponsmith

contracts.desc: The chief of Brukgrat wants the heads of a band of a score or so humans from the Clans of the Northern Fells roaming nearby. Kill them all within 9 days and the chief pays in coin.
contracts.title: Bring back human heads

contracts.desc: The Red Tusk Horde is at war with the Kingdom of the Middle March. A war band of humans is marching through the borderlands near Brukgrat; break it within 9 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.
contracts.title: War: break a war band of humans

contracts.desc: The Red Tusk Horde is at war with the Clans of the Northern Fells. A war band of humans is marching through the borderlands near Brukgrat; break it within 14 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.
contracts.title: War: break a war band of humans

contracts.desc: Wild Boars are killing livestock and worse around Brukgrat. Hunt them down within 8 days. They roam near the village; pelts and trophies are yours to sell.
contracts.title: Hunt the wild boars

contracts.desc: Merchants of Brukgrat need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 3 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 10 days.
contracts.title: Escort a caravan

contracts.desc: The lords of Brukgrat only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of goblins from the Warrens of Skrag is loose in the country. Destroy it within 13 days.
contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break goblins

__unit.backstory: Snar Gutripper fought his way up among the Gutrippers of Brukgrat, a war clan that keeps 12 acres of mixed crops and 13 cattle, and he has sweated as a keeper of the drover at Snar Gutripper's drover since the spring of year 1. After that, his daughter Ruzga Gutripper died in battle with the army that spring, and then his wife Murza Gutripper came home from the militia unpaid that winter. That winter, the Gutrippers came up 18 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the warchief. Very hot-tempered and still 19 coins in debt to the warchief, Snar bares his tusks at your table and demands plunder and a place in your war band, and one day he means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Snar Gutripper
__unit.title: keeper of the drover

__unit.backstory: Murza Gutripper was whelped among the Gutrippers, a war clan of Brukgrat that keeps 12 acres of mixed crops and 13 cattle, and she fought with the clan spears for four seasons in the spring of year 1. Her daughter Ruzga Gutripper went off to serve in the army of the Red Tusk Horde that spring, and then her daughter Ruzga Gutripper fell in battle with the army that spring. After that, the tax left the Gutrippers owing the warchief 18 coins that winter. A glutton, still 19 coins in debt to the warchief, Murza has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Murza Gutripper
__unit.title: cattle herder

__unit.backstory: Durz of the Red Tusk fought his way up among the Red Tusks of Brukgrat, a war clan that keeps 53 acres of mixed crops, 2 acres of flax, 20 acres of hay, 3 cattle and 24 pigs. He has sweated as a keeper of the woodcutter at Durz of the Red Tusk's woodcutter since the spring of year 1, and then his wife Orza of the Red Tusk fell in battle with the army that spring. That winter, the old hide-and-bone tent came down and nobody could pay to rebuild it, and then the tax left the Red Tusks owing the warchief 53 coins that winter. Very reckless and still 55 coins in debt to the warchief, Durz has come to fight for you for a share of the plunder, and he dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Durz of the Red Tusk
__unit.title: keeper of the woodcutter

__unit.backstory: Ghazka of the Red Tusk is of the Red Tusks, one of the brutal war clans of Brukgrat, who keep 53 acres of mixed crops, 2 acres of flax, 20 acres of hay, 3 cattle and 24 pigs. She spent two seasons in the clan's mixed crops in the spring of year 1, and she has sweated as a swineherd on the family herd since that summer. That winter, the Red Tusk hide-and-bone tent fell to ruin with no coin to mend it, and then the Red Tusks came up 53 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the warchief that winter. A glutton, still 55 coins in debt to the warchief, Ghazka bares her tusks at your table and demands plunder and a place in your war band, and one day she means to avenge her home.
__unit.name: Ghazka of the Red Tusk
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Oriel Moonmere is of House Moonmere in Aelorrin, a moon-elf house that keeps 5 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of apples, and she gave a few weeks to work as a bowyer's hand at Faelar Duskwhisper the younger's bowyer in the spring of year 1. She has worked the house's apples since that spring, but Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard stopped paying the Moonmeres that winter. Very cautious and two weeks unpaid now, Oriel stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Oriel Moonmere
__unit.title: farmhand on the apples

__unit.backstory: Gaeren Moonmere was born to House Moonmere of Aelorrin, who keep 5 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of apples beneath the moon. He served as a hired farmhand at Miralon Silverbough of household 100's Apple Orchard for a season in the autumn of year 1. After that, he gave a few weeks to work as a hired farmhand at Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard that winter, and he has worked as a fletcher's hand at Thalion Nightbloom's fletcher since that winter. But Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Moonmeres' wages that winter. Two weeks unpaid now, Gaeren stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Gaeren Moonmere
__unit.title: fletcher's hand

__unit.backstory: Lunaer Moonmere comes of House Moonmere, moon elves of Aelorrin who keep 5 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of apples, and he has worked the apples with the rest of the Moonmeres since the spring of year 1. But that winter, Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Moonmeres' wages. Very merciful and still owed two weeks of wages, Lunaer has come to lend you his blade for a sellsword's wage, and he dreams of avenging his home.
__unit.name: Lunaer Moonmere
__unit.title: farmhand on the apples

__unit.backstory: Myrrin Moonmere comes of House Moonmere, moon elves of Aelorrin who keep 5 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of apples, and she had no work for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. So she gave a few weeks to work as a hired farmhand at Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard that winter, but Aerendil Nightbloom the elder's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Moonmeres' wages that winter. Myrrin has had no work since that winter. Very even-tempered and unpaid for two weeks, she stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to see the world.
__unit.name: Myrrin Moonmere
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Faeryn Starfall was born to House Starfall of Aelorrin, who keep 4 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of apples and 4 goats beneath the moon, and she went with the caravans for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. That winter, she gave a few weeks to work as a hired farmhand at Vaelis Starfall the elder's Apple Orchard. She has had no work since that winter. The Starfalls borrowed 116 coins from the high council for food that winter. Very steady-nerved and still 174 coins in debt to the high council, Faeryn stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Faeryn Starfall
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Vaelis Starfall was born to House Starfall of Aelorrin, who keep 4 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of apples and 4 goats beneath the moon. He has worked as a goatherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. The Starfalls borrowed 116 coins from the high council for food that winter. Glory-hungry and still 174 coins in debt to the high council, Vaelis stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Vaelis Starfall
__unit.title: goatherd

contracts.desc: Scouts say Goblins of the Warrens of Skrag are massing to strike Ithmir within 7 days. Stop them before they reach the walls.
contracts.title: Defend Ithmir

contracts.desc: A band of a score or so goblins from the Warrens of Skrag has been preying on the roads around Ithmir. Find them and destroy them within 10 days.
contracts.title: Hunt down goblins

contracts.desc: A price is on the head of Mudking, a great wild boar from the boar wallow near Ithmir. The longer it lives, the more Ithmir pays. 10 days.
contracts.title: Bounty: Mudking

contracts.desc: Merchants of Ithmir need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 3 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 9 days.
contracts.title: Escort a caravan

contracts.desc: The lords of Ithmir only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of goblins from the Warrens of Skrag is loose in the country. Destroy it within 10 days.
contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break goblins

__unit.backstory: Faeryn Nightbloom was born to House Nightbloom of Ithmir, who keep 9 acres of mixed crops and 10 acres of pears beneath the moon. She has worked as a keeper of the tailor at Faeryn Nightbloom's tailor since the spring of year 1, but the tax left the Nightblooms owing the council 57 coins that winter. Very cautious and still 57 coins in debt to the council, Faeryn stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to see the world.
__unit.name: Faeryn Nightbloom
__unit.title: keeper of the tailor

__unit.backstory: Ithron Paleleaf was born to House Paleleaf of Ithmir, who own no field beneath the moon, so he gave three seasons to work as a smith's striker at Selune Moonmere's weapon forge in the spring of year 1. That winter, he did a few weeks with the caravans. Selune Moonmere's weapon forge stopped paying the Paleleafs that winter. Very generous and one week unpaid now, Ithron stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day he means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Ithron Paleleaf
__unit.title: smith's striker

__unit.backstory: Vaelith Paleleaf comes of House Paleleaf, moon elves of Ithmir who own no field, and Selune Moonmere's weapon forge fell behind with the Paleleafs' wages in the winter of year 1. One week unpaid now, Vaelith stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to command a company.
__unit.name: Vaelith Paleleaf
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Aerendil Duskwhisper was born to House Duskwhisper of Ithmir, who keep 7 acres of mixed crops, 8 acres of pears, 3 sheep and 5 horses beneath the moon. He gave three seasons to work as a shepherd on the family herd in the spring of year 1. His wife Myrrin Duskwhisper came home from the militia unpaid that spring, and then the tax left the Duskwhispers owing the council 53 coins that winter. Since that winter, Aerendil has worked as a horses herder on the family herd. He stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day he means to get rich.
__unit.name: Aerendil Duskwhisper
__unit.title: horses herder

__unit.backstory: Selune Paleleaf comes of House Paleleaf, moon elves of Ithmir who keep 3 acres of mixed crops and 4 acres of pears. She has worked the house's pears since the spring of year 1, but the Paleleafs came up 8 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the council that winter. Very cautious and still 6 coins in debt to the council, Selune stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to command a company.
__unit.name: Selune Paleleaf
__unit.title: farmhand on the pears

__unit.backstory: Rhaena Duskwhisper is of House Duskwhisper in Aelvalen, a moon-elf house that keeps 4 acres of mixed crops. She has worked the house's barley since the spring of year 1, but the tax left the Duskwhispers owing the council 32 coins that winter. Very passive and still 33 coins in debt to the council, Rhaena stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day she means to see the world.
__unit.name: Rhaena Duskwhisper
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Selune Nightbloom comes of House Nightbloom, moon elves of Aelvalen who keep 4 acres of mixed crops. She has worked the barley with the rest of the Nightblooms since the spring of year 1, but the Nightblooms came up 40 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the council that winter. Modest and still 40 coins in debt to the council, Selune has come to lend you her blade for a sellsword's wage, and she dreams of becoming a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Selune Nightbloom
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Yllara Moonmere was born to House Moonmere of Aelvalen, who keep 20 acres of mixed crops and 23 acres of pears beneath the moon, and the Moonmeres borrowed 165 coins from the council for food in the winter of year 1. The tax left the Moonmeres owing the council 91 coins that winter. Still 484 coins in debt to the council, Yllara has come to lend you her blade for a sellsword's wage, and she dreams of seeing the world.
__unit.name: Yllara Moonmere
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Taeron Nightbloom is of House Nightbloom in Aelvalen, a moon-elf house that keeps 3 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of pears and 6 goats, and he has worked as a keeper of the drover at Taeron Nightbloom's drover since the spring of year 1. But the Nightblooms came up 49 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the council that winter. Still 49 coins in debt to the council, Taeron stands before you and asks for honest pay, and one day he means to get rich.
__unit.name: Taeron Nightbloom
__unit.title: keeper of the drover

__unit.backstory: Sarnai of the Nine Tents was raised among the Nine Tentses, a steppe clan of Temirorda that keeps 10 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of grapes and 3 horses, and she worked the clan's mixed crops for a season in the autumn of year 1. She has been a keeper of the salt works at Sarnai of the Nine Tents's salt works since that winter, and then the flux took her brother Nogai of the Nine Tents that winter. Then, that winter, the tax left the Nine Tentses owing the khan 1 coins. Very unscrupulous and still 2 coins in debt to the khan, Sarnai has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Sarnai of the Nine Tents
__unit.title: keeper of the salt works

__unit.backstory: Ulan Saran was born to the Sarans, steppe people of Temirorda who keep 9 acres of mixed crops and 4 horses. He did a season in the militia in the spring of year 1. After that, his wife Hoelun Saran came home from the town guard unpaid that spring, and then the Sarans came up 13 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the khan that winter. Very steady-nerved and still 14 coins in debt to the khan, Ulan bows before you and asks for pay that comes every day, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Ulan Saran
__unit.title: horses herder

__unit.backstory: Hoelun Saran was raised among the Sarans, a steppe clan of Temirorda that keeps 9 acres of mixed crops and 4 horses, and she worked as a horses herder on the family herd for a few weeks in the spring of year 1. Then, that spring, her husband Ulan Saran came home from the militia unpaid, so Hoelun served with the caravans for a few weeks that spring. That winter, the Sarans came up 13 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the khan. A glutton, still 14 coins in debt to the khan, Hoelun bows before you and asks for pay that comes every day, and one day she means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Hoelun Saran
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Nogai Qara was raised among the Qaras, a steppe clan of Temirorda that owns no field, so he found work as a hired farmhand at Subutai Ordu's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. He worked as a hired farmhand at Sarnai of the Nine Tents's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks that winter, and he has been a salter's hand at Nogai Yeke's salter since that winter. But that winter, Sarnai of the Nine Tents's Vegetables Farm stopped paying the Qaras. Brave and still owed one week of wages, Nogai has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and he dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Nogai Qara
__unit.title: salter's hand

__unit.backstory: Yesugen Qara was raised among the Qaras, a steppe clan of Temirorda that owns no field, so she found work as a hired farmhand at Sorghaghtani of the Nine Tents's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. She worked as a kitchen hand for a few weeks that winter, and she has been a salter's hand at Nogai Yeke's salter since that winter. But that winter, Sarnai of the Nine Tents's Vegetables Farm stopped paying the Qaras. Still owed one week of wages, Yesugen has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Yesugen Qara
__unit.title: salter's hand

__unit.backstory: Jochi Arslanid was raised among the Arslanids, a steppe clan of Temirorda that keeps 14 acres of mixed crops, one acre of flax and one goat. His sister Tuya Arslanid walked home unpaid from the army of the Dust-Wind Khanate in the autumn of year 1, so Jochi worked as a hired farmhand at Jamuk Tolui's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks that winter. He has been a hired farmhand at Temur Saran's Vineyard since that winter, but Jamuk Tolui's Vegetables Farm fell behind with the Arslanids' wages that winter. Abstemious and still owed one week of wages, Jochi has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and he dreams of becoming a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Jochi Arslanid
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Arslan of the Grey Horse was born to the Grey Horses, steppe people of Altynsu who keep 12 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of grapes. His son Chagan of the Grey Horse went off to serve in the militia of Altynsu in the spring of year 1. After that, his son Chagan of the Grey Horse was killed defending the town that spring, and then the tax left the Grey Horses owing the bey 21 coins that winter. Very protective and still 22 coins in debt to the bey, Arslan has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and he dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Arslan of the Grey Horse
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Nogai Arslanid is of the Arslanids, a steppe clan of Altynsu that owns no field, and his daughter Sorghaghtani Arslanid died of marsh fever in the summer of year 1. So Nogai spent a season as a hired farmhand at Temur of the Grey Horse's Vineyard that autumn. After that, he found work as a hired farmhand at Bayar Ordu's Barley Farm for a few weeks that winter. He has been a hired farmhand at Temur of the Grey Horse's Vineyard since that winter. Very greedy and owed one week of wages, he has come to your camp for a fighter's share of the pay, and he dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Nogai Arslanid
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Bayar Ordu is of the Ordus, a steppe clan of Altynsu that keeps 12 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of grapes, and he has worked as a keeper of the builder at Bayar Ordu's builder since the spring of year 1. That autumn, his wife Ebegei Ordu walked home unpaid from the army of the Dust-Wind Khanate, and then the bey lent the clan 89 coins for food that winter. After that, his wife Ebegei Ordu went off to serve in the militia of Altynsu that winter. Loyal and owing the bey 89 coins, Bayar bows before you and asks for pay that comes every day, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Bayar Ordu
__unit.title: keeper of the builder

__unit.backstory: Tobin Thorne was born to the Thornes, a Thornstead family that keeps 8 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of apples and 2 sheep. The Thornes borrowed 73 coins from the reeve for food in the spring of year 1, and then his daughter-in-law Edith Thorne came home from the militia unpaid that autumn. The tax left the Thornes owing the reeve 52 coins that winter. Very protective and still 99 coins in debt to the reeve, Tobin has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Tobin Thorne
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Gerd Wexley grew up among the Wexleys in Thornstead, who own no field, and his son Bram Wexley walked home unpaid from the militia in the winter of year 1. Hugh Pike's Beans Farm stopped paying the Wexleys that winter. After that, winter cough took his grandson Baldwin Wexley that winter. Owed one week of wages, Gerd stands before you wanting a captain's pay, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Gerd Wexley
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Sorghaghtani Yeke was raised among the Yekes, a steppe clan of Akkent that keeps 28 acres of mixed crops, 14 acres of grapes, one acre of flax and 2 sheep. Her husband Jamuk Yeke went off to serve in the militia of Akkent in the autumn of year 1, and then Sorghaghtani spent a few weeks in the clan's mixed crops that autumn. But that autumn, the tax left the Yekes owing the bey 15 coins, so Sorghaghtani served with the caravans for a few weeks that winter. Glory-hungry and owing the bey 12 coins, she bows before you and asks for pay that comes every day, and one day she means to command a company.
__unit.name: Sorghaghtani Yeke
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Qutlug of the Grey Horse was born to the Grey Horses, steppe people of Akkent who own no field, so he worked as a hired farmhand at Chagan Qara's Hay Farm for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. He spent a few weeks as a brewer's hand at Bora Ordu's brewer that winter, and he has worked as a hired farmhand at Altan Khasar's Vineyard since that winter. But Altan Khasar's Vineyard fell behind with the Grey Horses' wages that winter. Very aggressive and one week unpaid now, Qutlug bows before you and asks for pay that comes every day, and one day he means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Qutlug of the Grey Horse
__unit.title: hired farmhand

contracts.desc: A band of a score or so orcs from the Red Tusk Horde has been preying on the roads around Stonevault. Find them and destroy them within 10 days.

contracts.desc: Merchants of Stonevault need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 3 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 9 days.

contracts.desc: The lords of Stonevault only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of orcs from the Red Tusk Horde is loose in the country. Destroy it within 10 days.

__unit.backstory: Zasit Granitejaw is of Clan Granitejaw in Stonevault, a clan that keeps 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, one sheep and 2 goats, and he has worked as a keeper of the brewer at Zasit Granitejaw's brewer since the spring of year 1, close to the beer he likes. After that, his son Rigoth Granitejaw went off to serve in the militia of Stonevault that spring. The Granitejaws borrowed 187 coins from the king under the mountain for food that autumn, and then his son Rigoth Granitejaw walked home unpaid from the militia that autumn. Very passive and owing the king under the mountain 237 coins, Zasit would put his name to your roll for a fighter's wage, counted daily, and one day he means to see the world.
__unit.name: Zasit Granitejaw
__unit.title: keeper of the brewer

__unit.backstory: Rigoth Granitejaw was born to Clan Granitejaw of Stonevault, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, one sheep and 2 goats. He did three seasons in the hold's militia in the spring of year 1. The Granitejaws borrowed 187 coins from the king under the mountain for food that autumn. Very modest and still 237 coins in debt to the king under the mountain, Rigoth has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and he dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Rigoth Granitejaw
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Domas Granitejaw comes of Clan Granitejaw, Stonevault dwarves who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, one sheep and 2 goats. She has worked as a goatherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. After that, her son Rigoth Granitejaw went off to serve in the militia of Stonevault that spring. After that, the king under the mountain lent the clan 187 coins for food that autumn. Her son Rigoth Granitejaw came home from the militia unpaid that autumn. Very aggressive and owing the king under the mountain 237 coins, Domas would put her name to your roll for a fighter's wage, counted daily, and one day she means to get rich.
__unit.name: Domas Granitejaw
__unit.title: goatherd

__unit.backstory: Onol Anvilbrow is of Clan Anvilbrow in Stonevault, a clan that keeps 7 acres of mixed crops and 6 sheep, and she has been a shepherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. But the Anvilbrows came up 19 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the king under the mountain that winter. Very loyal and still 40 coins in debt to the king under the mountain, Onol has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Onol Anvilbrow
__unit.title: shepherd

__unit.backstory: Rakust Granitejaw is of Clan Granitejaw in Stonevault, a clan that keeps 6 acres of mixed crops, 3 acres of apples and 2 pigs, and the tax left the Granitejaws owing the king under the mountain 10 coins in the winter of year 1. A glutton, still 13 coins in debt to the king under the mountain, Rakust has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and she dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Rakust Granitejaw
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Solon Granitejaw is of Clan Granitejaw in Stonevault, a clan that keeps 6 acres of mixed crops, 3 acres of apples and 2 pigs. He has been a swineherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1, but the Granitejaws came up 10 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the king under the mountain that winter. Loyal and still 13 coins in debt to the king under the mountain, Solon has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Solon Granitejaw
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Tosid Granitejaw was born to Clan Granitejaw of Stonevault, who keep 6 acres of mixed crops, 3 acres of apples and 2 pigs. She went in the hold's militia for two seasons in the spring of year 1, and then she put in a season as a swineherd on the family herd that autumn. Since that winter, she has worked the clan's mixed crops, but the tax left the Granitejaws owing the king under the mountain 10 coins that winter. Still 13 coins in debt to the king under the mountain, Tosid would put her name to your roll for a fighter's wage, counted daily, and one day she means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Tosid Granitejaw
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Lolor Stonebeard was born to Clan Stonebeard of Emberforge, who own no field, so she put in a few weeks as a street sweeper in the autumn of year 1. After that, she laboured as a hired farmhand at Doren Anvilbrow's Vineyard for a season that autumn, but Doren Anvilbrow's Vineyard fell behind with the Stonebeards' wages that winter. Since that winter, Lolor has stood idle. Owed two weeks of wages, she has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and she dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Lolor Stonebeard
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Mistem Oakenshield is of Clan Oakenshield in Emberforge, a clan that owns no field, and she stood idle for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. And so she laboured as a chandler's hand at Zasit Hammerfall's chandler for a few weeks that winter, but Doren Anvilbrow's Vineyard fell behind with the Oakenshields' wages that winter. Mistem has stood idle since that winter. Very glory-hungry and owed two weeks of wages, she has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and she dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Mistem Oakenshield
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Erith Stonebeard comes of Clan Stonebeard, Emberforge dwarves who own no field. Doren Anvilbrow's Vineyard stopped paying the Stonebeards in the winter of year 1. Very aggressive and still owed two weeks of wages, Erith has come to swear to your company for fair pay in good bronze, and he dreams of becoming a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Erith Stonebeard
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Brita Dunmore is one of the Dunmores of Marlmere, who own no field. Gerd Thorne's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Dunmores' wages in the winter of year 1. Two weeks unpaid now, Brita stands before you wanting a captain's pay, and one day she means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Brita Dunmore
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Hugh Dunmore comes from the Dunmores of Marlmere, who own no field, so he worked as a hired farmhand at Roderic Longshank's Vegetables Farm for two seasons in the summer of year 1. Then, that winter, he spent a season as a hired farmhand at Gerd Thorne's Apple Orchard, but Gerd Thorne's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Dunmores' wages that winter. Since that winter, Hugh has worked as a hired farmhand at Ivo Ironside's Beans Farm. Very cautious and unpaid for two weeks, he has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Hugh Dunmore
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Agnes Stone comes from the Stones of Marlmere, who own no field, so she worked as a kitchen hand for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. She spent a few weeks as a hired farmhand at Brannoc Underhill's Barley And Oats Farm that autumn, and she has worked as a hired farmhand at Gerd Thorne's Apple Orchard since that winter. But Gerd Thorne's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Stones' wages that winter. Very merciful and one week unpaid now, Agnes has come to you for a wage that comes every day, and one day she means to avenge her home.
__unit.name: Agnes Stone
__unit.title: hired farmhand

contracts.desc: A band of about a dozen orcs from the Red Tusk Horde has been preying on the roads around Hrafnstad. Find them and destroy them within 12 days.
contracts.title: Hunt down orcs

contracts.desc: The Clans of the Northern Fells is at war with the Red Tusk Horde. A war band of orcs is marching through the borderlands near Hrafnstad; break it within 9 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.

contracts.title: Bounty: Greymuzzle

contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break humans

__unit.backstory: Sigrun Holloway comes of the Holloways, fell-folk of Hrafnstad who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, 2 cattle and one sheep, and her daughter-in-law Greta Holloway came home from the militia unpaid in the summer of year 1. That winter, the tax left the Holloways owing the jarl 17 coins, and then her granddaughter Hild Holloway died of winter cough that winter. Very brave and owing the jarl 16 coins, Sigrun offers you her arm for a fighter's pay, paid every day, and one day she means to avenge her home.
__unit.name: Sigrun Holloway
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Ivo Holloway was raised by the Holloways of Hrafnstad, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, 2 cattle and one sheep, and he has been a shepherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. After that, his wife Greta Holloway walked home unpaid from the militia that summer, and then the tax left the Holloways owing the jarl 17 coins that winter. Then, that winter, winter cough took his daughter Hild Holloway. Very merciful and 16 coins in debt to the jarl, Ivo has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and he dreams of seeing the world.
__unit.name: Ivo Holloway
__unit.title: cattle herder

__unit.backstory: Greta Holloway is of the Holloways, a Hrafnstad household of the fells that keeps 10 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, 2 cattle and one sheep, and she went in the militia for a season in the spring of year 1. After that, the Holloways came up 17 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the jarl that winter, and then her daughter Hild Holloway died of winter cough that winter. A loner, owing the jarl 16 coins, Greta offers you her arm for a fighter's pay, paid every day, and one day she means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Greta Holloway
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Orrin Underhill is of the Underhills, a Hrafnstad household of the fells that owns no field, so he spent a few weeks as a herbalist's hand at Odo Stone's herbalist in the autumn of year 1. He found work as a hired farmhand at Yorick Ironside's Beans And Vegetables Farm for a few weeks that autumn. He has been a woodcutter at Bram Thorne's woodcutter since that winter, but Merrick Longshank's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Underhills' wages that winter. Very even-tempered and still owed one week of wages, Orrin has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Orrin Underhill
__unit.title: woodcutter

__unit.backstory: Helga Underhill was raised by the Underhills of Hrafnstad, who own no field, so she found work as a hired farmhand at Bram Thorne's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. Then, that winter, she worked as a hired farmhand at Yorick Ironside's Beans And Vegetables Farm for a few weeks, and she has worked as a woodcutter at Bram Thorne's woodcutter since that winter, handy with the axes she likes. But that winter, Merrick Longshank's Apple Orchard fell behind with the Underhills' wages. Merciful and one week unpaid now, Helga offers you her arm for a fighter's pay, paid every day, and one day she means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Helga Underhill
__unit.title: woodcutter

contracts.desc: Scouts say Humans of the Kingdom of the Middle March are massing to strike Ormrholm within 6 days. Stop them before they reach the walls.
contracts.title: Defend Ormrholm

contracts.desc: A band of a score or so humans from the Kingdom of the Middle March has been preying on the roads around Ormrholm. Find them and destroy them within 10 days.
contracts.title: Hunt down humans

contracts.desc: The Clans of the Northern Fells is at war with the Red Tusk Horde. A war band of orcs is marching through the borderlands near Ormrholm; break it within 10 days. Taking a side in a war earns friends and enemies both.
contracts.title: War: break a war band of orcs

contracts.desc: Wolves are killing livestock and worse around Ormrholm. Hunt them down within 6 days. They roam near the village; pelts and trophies are yours to sell.
contracts.title: Hunt the wolves

contracts.desc: Merchants of Ormrholm need guards for a caravan on the road to the next town, about 3 days away. The caravan waits for you at the gate; stay close to it. Deliver it within 9 days.
contracts.title: Escort a caravan

contracts.desc: The lords of Ormrholm only offer this to companies they trust: a strong band of goblins from the Warrens of Skrag is loose in the country. Destroy it within 12 days.
contracts.title: Veteran's contract: break goblins

__unit.backstory: Nell Pike is of the Pikes, an Ormrholm household of the fells that keeps 9 acres of mixed crops and 14 sheep, and she spent a season as a hired farmhand at Godric Wexley's Barley Farm in the spring of year 1. She worked the household's mixed crops for two seasons that summer, but the Pikes came up 36 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the jarl that winter. Since that winter, Nell has been a shepherd on the family herd. Very unscrupulous and 37 coins in debt to the jarl, she has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Nell Pike
__unit.title: shepherd

__unit.backstory: Brannoc Blackmere was raised by the Blackmeres of Ormrholm, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops and 9 sheep. He has been a shepherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1, and then his wife Elin Blackmere walked home unpaid from the militia that autumn. That winter, the flux took his son Marek Blackmere, and then the Blackmeres came up 15 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the jarl that winter. Even-tempered and still 15 coins in debt to the jarl, Brannoc has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and he dreams of buying land and settling.
__unit.name: Brannoc Blackmere
__unit.title: shepherd

__unit.backstory: Roderic Dunmore was raised by the Dunmores of Ormrholm, who keep 10 acres of mixed crops, 4 acres of apples and 7 sheep, and he has worked as a keeper of the smelter at Roderic Dunmore's smelter since the spring of year 1, handy with the maces he likes. But that winter, the tax left the Dunmores owing the jarl 13 coins. Very glory-hungry and still 14 coins in debt to the jarl, Roderic offers you his arm for a fighter's pay, paid every day, and one day he means to avenge his home.
__unit.name: Roderic Dunmore
__unit.title: keeper of the smelter

__unit.backstory: Wenna Fenwick comes of the Fenwicks, fell-folk of Ormrholm who keep 9 acres of mixed crops, 4 horses and 14 sheep, and she has worked the barley with the rest of the Fenwicks since the spring of year 1. Her husband Ewan Fenwick walked home unpaid from the militia that summer, and then her daughter Hild Fenwick died of the flux that summer. The tax left the Fenwicks owing the jarl 39 coins that winter. Very hot-tempered and still 40 coins in debt to the jarl, Wenna has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Wenna Fenwick
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Ada Wexley comes of the Wexleys, fell-folk of Ormrholm who keep 12 acres of mixed crops and 6 acres of apples. Her granddaughter Clara Wexley went off to serve in the militia of Ormrholm in the spring of year 1, and then her granddaughter Clara Wexley walked home unpaid from the militia that autumn. Very glory-hungry, Ada has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Ada Wexley
__unit.title: past working age

__unit.backstory: Liesel Vane is of the Vanes, a Hrafnby household of the fells that keeps 13 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, one pig and 8 sheep, and she has been a shepherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. But that winter, the tax left the Vanes owing the jarl 8 coins. Very brave and still 8 coins in debt to the jarl, Liesel has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of getting rich.
__unit.name: Liesel Vane
__unit.title: shepherd

__unit.backstory: Ivo Vane is of the Vanes, a Hrafnby household of the fells that keeps 13 acres of mixed crops, 5 acres of apples, one pig and 8 sheep. He has been a keeper of the brewer at Ivo Vane's brewer since the spring of year 1, close to the beer he likes, but the Vanes came up 8 coins short on the tax and ended up owing the jarl that winter. Very brave and still 8 coins in debt to the jarl, Ivo has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Ivo Vane
__unit.title: keeper of the brewer

__unit.backstory: Nell Stone was raised by the Stones of Hrafnby, who keep 6 acres of mixed crops and 8 sheep, and she worked as a hired farmhand at Ivo Holloway's Apple Orchard for a few weeks in the winter of year 1. Since that winter, she has been a hired farmhand at Tobin Greaves's Vegetables Farm. Her sister Mina Stone died of the flux that winter. After that, Tobin Greaves's Vegetables Farm fell behind with the Stones' wages that winter. Very cruel and still owed one week of wages, Nell has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of seeing the world.
__unit.name: Nell Stone
__unit.title: farmhand on the mixed crops

__unit.backstory: Hanne Stone is of the Stones, a Hrafnby household of the fells that keeps 6 acres of mixed crops and 8 sheep, and she has been a shepherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. Then, that winter, the flux took her daughter Mina Stone, and then Tobin Greaves's Vegetables Farm stopped paying the Stones that winter. Very brave and still owed one week of wages, Hanne has come down to your table for a sword-hand's wage, and she dreams of becoming a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Hanne Stone
__unit.title: shepherd

__unit.backstory: Nax Quickknife was spawned into the Quickknifes, a Nibnook brood that owns no field, so he scraped by as a hired farmhand at Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm for a season in the autumn of year 1. He spent a season as a hired farmhand at Nax Sharpgrin of household 60's Fig Orchard that winter, but Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm cheated the Quickknifes of their wages that winter. Nax has had no work since that winter. Very greedy and unpaid for two weeks, he offers you his knife for first pick of the plunder, and one day he means to see the world.
__unit.name: Nax Quickknife
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Grib Quickknife clawed up among the Quickknifes, a Nibnook brood that owns no field, so he scraped by as a hired farmhand at Mog of Skrag the elder's Beans And Figs Farm for a season in the autumn of year 1. After that, he spent a season as a hired farmhand at Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm that winter, but Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm cheated the Quickknifes of their wages that winter. Since that winter, Grib has scraped by as a hired farmhand at Nax Sharpgrin of household 60's Fig Orchard. Very unscrupulous and unpaid for two weeks, he grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and one day he means to earn a name.
__unit.name: Grib Quickknife
__unit.title: hired farmhand

__unit.backstory: Pip Quickknife clawed up among the Quickknifes, a Nibnook brood that owns no field, so she scraped by as a hired farmhand at Mog Mudfoot's Vegetables Farm for a few weeks in the autumn of year 1. That autumn, she spent a season as a hired farmhand at Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm, but Rotz the Sly the younger's Beans And Figs Farm cheated the Quickknifes of their wages that winter. Since that winter, Pip has had no work. Very unscrupulous and unpaid for two weeks, she grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and one day she means to see the world.
__unit.name: Pip Quickknife
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Kizza Quickknife clawed up among the Quickknifes, a Nibnook brood that keeps 16 pigs. Her sister Zibb Quickknife went off to serve in the militia of Nibnook in the spring of year 1. After that, The Pit stiffed the Quickknifes of their pay that winter. One week unpaid now, Kizza grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and one day she means to become a legendary warrior.
__unit.name: Kizza Quickknife
__unit.title: out of work

__unit.backstory: Jix Quickknife clawed up among the Quickknifes, a Mudwarren brood that owns no field, so he has scraped by as a keeper of the salt works at Jix Quickknife's salt works since the spring of year 1. His wife Ditta Quickknife was killed defending the town that spring, and then Kribb Mudfoot's Fig Orchard stiffed the Quickknifes of their pay that winter. Then, that winter, his wife Nissa Quickknife went off to serve in the militia of Mudwarren. Very cruel and owed one week of wages, Jix grins at you and asks for a cut of the loot, and he dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Jix Quickknife
__unit.title: keeper of the salt works

__unit.backstory: Nax Quickknife is of the Quickknife brood in the Mudwarren warrens, who keep 15 acres of mixed crops and 8 acres of figs. He has scraped by as a keeper of the leatherworker at Nax Quickknife the younger's leatherworker since the spring of year 1, handy with the knives he likes. His son Yip Quickknife went off to serve in the militia of Mudwarren that summer. The taskmaster lent the brood 170 coins for food that winter, and then his son Yip Quickknife was killed defending the town that winter. Very selfish and 1143 coins in debt to the taskmaster, Nax has slunk up to your table for your coin and a warm bed in every town, and he dreams of commanding a company.
__unit.name: Nax Quickknife
__unit.title: keeper of the leatherworker

__unit.backstory: Wrag Mudfoot was spawned into the Mudfoots, a Mudwarren brood that keeps 37 acres of mixed crops and 19 acres of figs. He has scraped by as a keeper of the armorsmith at Kribb of Skrag's armour forge since the spring of year 1. After that, his wife Ditta Mudfoot came home from the militia unpaid that spring, and then the Mudfoots borrowed 310 coins from the taskmaster for food that winter. That winter, his wife Ditta Mudfoot went off to serve in the militia of Mudwarren. Very cruel and 390 coins in debt to the taskmaster, Wrag offers you his knife for first pick of the plunder, and he dreams of earning a name.
__unit.name: Wrag Mudfoot
__unit.title: keeper of the armorsmith

__unit.backstory: Pog Mudfoot is of the Mudfoot brood in the Skragsump warrens, who keep 15 acres of mixed crops, 9 acres of grapes, 27 pigs and 22 goats, and he has scraped by as a goatherd on the family herd since the spring of year 1. That autumn, the taskmaster lent the brood 207 coins for food. Very cowardly and still 453 coins in debt to the taskmaster, Pog has slunk up to your table for your coin and a warm bed in every town, and one day he means to command a company.
__unit.name: Pog Mudfoot
__unit.title: swineherd

__unit.backstory: Tizzle Mudfoot was spawned into the Mudfoots, a Skragsump brood that keeps 16 acres of mixed crops, 9 acres of grapes and 25 goats, and her grandson Snik Mudfoot was killed in battle with the army in the spring of year 1. That autumn, her daughter-in-law Kizza Mudfoot went off to serve in the militia of Skragsump, and then the Mudfoots borrowed 311 coins from the taskmaster for food that winter. Very aggressive and still 421 coins in debt to the taskmaster, Tizzle offers you her knife for first pick of the plunder, and one day she means to buy land and settle.
__unit.name: Tizzle Mudfoot
__unit.title: past working age
